summary.text: James Shade is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Jordan Ridley.
Shade, who lives in Cobb County, has a background in corporate law and media, and he was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Shade lives in Cobb County, Georgia, and earned a bachelor's degree from National University and a law degree from Florida State University College of Law.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an on-air radio personality, youth mentor and corporate legal professional, and says he has been affiliated with Organizing for America and Children's Healthcare of Atlanta.
Shade ran for District 22 in 2024, when incumbent Republican Jordan Ridley defeated him in the general election, 60.5 percent to 39.5 percent.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Cobb County resident of 18 years, a husband and father of three, and the founder and operator of a multimedia company.
